name: Pig
description: Pig is a simple collecting card game of American origin in which players pass one card at a time to the left and try to collect four cards of the same rank; the first to get four of a kind touches their nose and the last to do so loses the deal. Often played with three lives (letters P-I-G) or as Spoons using tokens.

history.origins:
Country/Region of Origin: USA
Time Period: Early 20th century (first recorded 1911)
Historical Development: Pig is of American origin; it may be descended from the older game Vive l'Amour (documented in German literature from 1821). Pig was first recorded in 1911; the variant Donkey appears by 1957, Spoons by 1990.
Cultural Significance: Popular children's and party game in the US and elsewhere.
timeline: Modern Era: Continues to be played worldwide
